results.title: Principles of radio. Part 3. The Vacuum tube
results.creator_credit: Encyclopaedia Britannica Films and ERPI Classroom Films
results.brief_description: Explains by animated drawings, the operation of a radio vacuum tube in terms of its filament, plate, and grid circuits. Illustrates the three functions of the vacuum tube in radio: how it serves as an amplifier to operate the loud-speaker, as a rectifier in detection, and as an oscillator to generate the carrier wave.

results.title: Principles of radio. Part 2. Receiving radio messages
results.brief_description: The general principles of the radio receiver are explained, and the following points treated in detail: the problem of tuning; the capacity of a variable condenser; the inductance of a coil; resonance; detection, and how a crystal is used as a detector; the operation of an earphone; the production of audible sound waves.

results.title: Principles of orbit
results.brief_description:
Episode of Series “Space Science”.
How do the laws of inertia and universal gravitation govern the flight of an orbiting satellite? This program investigates the question by demonstrating the behaviour of a satellite, both in circular and elliptical orbit.

results.title: Principles of lubrication
results.creator_credit: Peter De Normanville and Antony Barrier Productions
results.brief_description: Demonstrates two simple law of friction which comes into play when two solid surfaces come into contact with a fluid interposed. Examples of important machines in which such contacts occur are given with a variety of conditions ranging from complete separation of surfaces by a film of fluid to the case where no fluid at all is present. Discusses ways of reducing wear and friction, lubricants viscosity and modes o lubrication.

results.title: Principles of electricity
results.brief_description: Breaks down the structure of matter into atoms and shows the action of electron within an atom. Explains the units of pressure, electric current and resistance (the volt, ampere, and ohm) as the principles involved in the flow of electricity. Discusses the essence of magnetism and magnetic fields. Shows how magnetic fields function in the generation and application of electricity.
